reuse_decisions_proposed.identity: Managed B2B identity; WorkOS AuthKit vs Clerk spike before selection.
reuse_decisions_proposed.workflow: Temporal for durable business orchestration; simpler platform jobs where Temporal semantics are unnecessary.
reuse_decisions_proposed.integrations: Nango-first for multi-tenant OAuth/API connectivity; direct vendor APIs for strategic connectors; Airbyte only for ELT.
reuse_decisions_proposed.mcp: Official vendor MCP preferred; production admission by trust tier; evaluate Cloudflare MCP Server Portals as governed access layer.
reuse_decisions_proposed.ai: Nexus-owned gateway contract; provider/aggregator replaceable; Langfuse observability separate from billing ledger.
reuse_decisions_proposed.billing: Stripe for payments/invoices; OpenMeter-class meter for credits/usage if needed; reconcile against vendor invoices.
reuse_decisions_proposed.source_of_truth: Low-code/CRM/helpdesk/workflow tools must not replace Nexus canonical project/task truth.
